cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pens on the sofa arm like yours. Sensible. That ink stain must be from the delivery label.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's capped. You uncapped yours to sign, and the label's dry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, signatures first. They must have brushed my signature against the fabric. We should photograph it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your nib's dripping straight onto the cushion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They must have cracked my pen squeezing past me. Photograph that too; it's a second claim.
